items.title: Verizon (VZ) Lands Global Race Day IoT Connectivity Deal With Major Motorsport Customer
items.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) has been selected by Bosch Motorsport to provide global IoT connectivity for race-day operations. Bosch Motorsport will use Verizon's Global IoT Orchestration and ThingSpace platform to manage data links across international race events. The agreement focuses on real-time telemetry and mission-critical data flows at tracks worldwide, supporting Bosch Motorsport customers and teams.
